[32m+[m[32m# BÁO CÁO BỔ SUNG — 2026-11-18 (Test 978 case, fuzz + đối chiếu SPEC)[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m**Phạm vi:** 913 file corpus (valid/invalid/edge + 584 token-mutant + 200 byte-mutant) + 65 ca targeted = **978 case**.[m
[32m+[m[32m**Phương pháp:** chạy `./zig-out/bin/ko <file> </dev/null` cho từng file; phân loại RC (0=OK, 2=parse error, 3=runtime error, 134/139=crash); đối chiếu SPEC; debug từng ca đáng ngờ bằng `ko run`.[m
[32m+[m[32m**Ràng buộc:** KHÔNG sửa source. Chỉ ghi nhận + truy nguyên.[m
[32m+[m[32m**Kết quả tổng:** `zig build` rc=0; `zig build test </dev/null` EXIT=0 (15/15). **0 crash** trong 978 case (di chứng BUG-1/2/6 đã fix giữ vững). RC histogram: `{2: ~730, 0: ~110, 3: ~79}`.[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m> **Lưu ý quan trọng:** Các lỗi dưới đây là **parity/spec gap** (chương trình chạy nhưng sai kết quả, hoặc cú pháp hợp lệ theo SPEC bị từ chối), **KHÔNG phải crash**. Chúng nguy hiểm hơn crash vì không ai phát hiện.[m

[32m+[m[32m## 🔴 Nhóm A — Cú pháp hợp lệ theo SPEC bị parser từ chối (rc=2)[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m### A1. Tuple / list literal `(1,2,3)` không parse được[m
[32m+[m[32m- **File:** `src/parser_expr.zig` (`parsePrimaryExpr` nhánh `.l_paren`, ~L389–460)[m
[32m+[m[32m- **Triệu chứng:**[m
[32m+[m[32m  ```[m
[32m+[m[32m  [ (1,2,3)~t <printf>^(t) ]        → rc=2  error: ExpectedRParen at 1:6..1:7[m
[32m+[m[32m  [ ('a','b')~t ]                    → rc=2[m
[32m+[m[32m  [ (1('a','b'))~a ]                 → rc=2  (nested list)[m
[32m+[m[32m  ```[m
[32m+[m[32m- **SPEC:** §III.2 định nghĩa tuple/number array `(1,2)~a`, string array `('a','b')~b`, nested list `(1('a','b'))~list` đều hợp lệ.[m
[32m+[m[32m- **Root cause:** Parser chỉ coi `(...)` là "một biểu thức đơn" (comment `// normal parenthesized expression (possibly tuple? treat as single)`). Sau `parseExpression()` cho phần tử đầu, nếu gặp `,` thì không xử lý → `expectRParen()` fail.[m
[32m+[m[32m- **Mức độ:** HIGH — tuple/list là kiểu dữ liệu cơ bản theo SPEC.[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m### A2. System tag với sigil `$` (`<$random>(...)`, `<$os>(...)`) không parse[m
[32m+[m[32m- **File:** `src/parser_expr.zig:8` (`parseSystemTagName` chỉ nhận `.keyword`/`.identifier`, KHÔNG nhận `.dollar`)[m
[32m+[m[32m- **Triệu chứng:**[m
[32m+[m[32m  ```[m
[32m+[m[32m  **Import**($Random)@also%~random!`global`:random[m
[32m+[m[32m  [ int(<$random>(1,5))~r <printf>^(r) ][m
[32m+[m[32m  → rc=2  error: UnexpectedToken at 2:57..2:58[m
[32m+[m[32m  ```[m
[32m+[m[32m  Trong khi `<printf>`, `<len>`, `<if>` (tag thường) chạy tốt.[m
[32m+[m[32m- **SPEC:** §VII.1 ví dụ chuẩn `int(<$random>(1, 100))~rand_val`; §VII.3 `int(<$random>(0, inv_len - 1))~item_index`. Đây là cú pháp chính thức để gọi hàm module đã import.[m
[32m+[m[32m- **Root cause:** `parseSystemTagName` (dùng chung cho cả statement & expr path) không xử lý token `.dollar`. Khi gặp `<` rồi `$`, nó trả `error.UnexpectedToken` vì `$` không phải keyword/identifier.[m
[32m+[m[32m- **Mức độ:** HIGH — chặn toàn bộ việc dùng module đã import (Random/Os/Website).[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m### A3. `bytes(<encode(...)>)` không parse[m
[32m+[m[32m- **File:** `src/parser_expr.zig` (parse `bytes(` arg — gặp `.lt` lồng trong `.l_paren` của `bytes(...)`)[m
[32m+[m[32m- **Triệu chứng:**[m
[32m+[m[32m  ```[m
[32m+[m[32m  [ bytes(<encode(`ASCII`)>^("hi"))~b ... ]  → rc=2[m
[32m+[m[32m  ```[m
[32m+[m[32m- **SPEC:** §IV.2 ví dụ chuẩn `bytes(<encode(`UTF-8`)>^("Secure data\n"))~encoded_data`.[m
[32m+[m[32m- **Mức độ:** MEDIUM — encoding lồng trong bytes allocation.[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m## 🔴 Nhóm B — Chương trình chạy (rc=0) nhưng SAI KẾT QUẢ[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m### B1. `<print>string^("x={x}")` KHÔNG nội suy biến[m
[32m+[m[32m- **File:** `src/vm_value_ops.zig` — handler `print` (khác `printf`)[m
[32m+[m[32m- **Triệu chứng:**[m
[32m+[m[32m  ```[m
[32m+[m[32m  [ int(7)~x <print>string^("x={x}\n") ]  → in "x={x}"  ❌ (mong đợi "x=7")[m
[32m+[m[32m  [ int(7)~x <printf>^("x={x}\n") ]       → in "x=7"    ✅[m
[32m+[m[32m  ```[m
[32m+[m[32m- **SPEC:** §IV.1 `<print>string^("Xin chao\n")` — cùng họ với printf, phải nội suy.[m
[32m+[m[32m- **Root cause:** Chỉ `printf` gọi `printInterpolated`; `print` in thẳng string. (BUG-3 cũ fix cho `printf` nhưng `<print>` bị bỏ sót.)[m
[32m+[m[32m- **Mức độ:** HIGH — sai kết quả âm thầm.[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m### B2. `bytes(N)` rồi `<len>` trả 0 thay vì N[m
[32m+[m[32m- **File:** `src/vm.zig` (var_decl bytes ~L259–285) + `src/vm_value_ops.zig` (tag `len` ~L637)[m
[32m+[m[32m- **Triệu chứng:**[m
[32m+[m[32m  ```[m
[32m+[m[32m  [ bytes(8)~b int(<len>^(b))~l <printf>^("len={l}\n") ]  → in "len=0"  ❌ (mong đợi 8)[m
[32m+[m[32m  [ bytes("AB")~b int(<len>^(b))~l <printf>^(l) ]         → in "2"    ✅[m
[32m+[m[32m  ```[m
[32m+[m[32m- **SPEC:** §IV.6 `bytes(16)~empty_buf` là buffer 16 byte; §IV.3 `int(<len>^(buffer))~buf_size` phải ra kích thước buffer.[m
[32m+[m[32m- **Root cause:** var_decl `bytes` với arg `.int` cấp phát `alloc(u8, i)` + `@memset(0)` nhưng `<len>` trả 0 — nghi `len` đọc `.bytes` ra rỗng, hoặc con trỏ bị deinit sớm. (Đối chứng: `bytes("AB")` cho len=2 đúng → lỗi chỉ ở nhánh `.int`.)[m
[32m+[m[32m- **Mức độ:** HIGH — buffer allocation vô dụng nếu len luôn 0.[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m### B3. Class method call `$f~get()` — NameError: UndefinedVariable[m
[32m+[m[32m- **File:** `src/vm_value_ops.zig:197` (`callUserFunction` không bind `self`)[m
[32m+[m[32m- **Triệu chứng:**[m
[32m+[m[32m  ```[m
[32m+[m[32m  Foo !class [ int(5)~x get() [ <return>(x) ] ][m
[32m+[m[32m  [ ~Foo~f int($f~get())~r <printf>^(r) ][m
[32m+[m[32m  → rc=3  NameError: UndefinedVariable  ❌[m
[32m+[m[32m  ```[m
[32m+[m[32m  Trong khi `$f~x` (member access) trả 5 đúng.[m
[32m+[m[32m- **SPEC:** §VIII.1 ví dụ chuẩn `int($m1~take_damage())~remaining_hp`.[m
[32m+[m[32m- **Root cause:** `evaluateCall` khi gặp `.class_instance` lấy `func` từ `ci.methods` rồi gọi `callUserFunction(f, call.args)`. `callUserFunction` tạo scope mới từ `func.closure_scope` — **không** bind instance fields (`x`) vào scope. Method `get()` đọc `x` → không thấy → `UndefinedVariable`.[m
[32m+[m[32m- **Mức độ:** HIGH — OOP method hoàn toàn không dùng được.[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m### B4. `<catch>` đặt SAU câu lệnh lỗi không bắt được[m
[32m+[m[32m- **File:** `src/vm.zig` (catch_stmt handler ~L583)[m
[32m+[m[32m- **Triệu chứng:**[m
[32m+[m[32m  ```[m
[32m+[m[32m  [ int(1)~a int(0)~b int(a/b)~c <catch>(`DivideByZeroError`) [ <printf>^("caught") ] ][m
[32m+[m[32m  → rc=3  (không in "caught")  ❌[m
[32m+[m[32m  ```[m
[32m+[m[32m  Trong khi `<catch>` đặt TRƯỚC câu lệnh lỗi thì bắt được:[m
[32m+[m[32m  ```[m
[32m+[m[32m  [ <catch>(`DivideByZeroError`) [ <printf>^("caught") ] int(1)/0 ... ] → in "caught" ✅[m
[32m+[m[32m  ```[m
[32m+[m[32m- **SPEC:** §IX.2 "Global Catch: Scans backward protecting all Functions/Main Blocks preceding it" — catch chỉ quét LẬI (backward) các câu lệnh ĐỨNG TRƯỚC nó. Đặt sau câu lỗi thì lỗi đã xảy ra trước khi catch được "cài" → không bắt.[m
[32m+[m[32m- **Đánh giá:** Đây là **hành vi ĐÚNG theo SPEC** (backward scan). Không phải bug — chỉ là thứ tự code sai. Ghi nhận để làm rõ.[m
[32m+[m[32m- **Mức độ:** N/A (đúng spec).[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m### B5. `type(x)` / `type("hi")` — UndefinedFunction[m
[32m+[m[32m- **File:** `src/vm_value_ops.zig:648` (có xử lý tag `type` trong `callBuiltin`) nhưng `evaluateCall` không tới được[m
[32m+[m[32m- **Triệu chứng:**[m
[32m+[m[32m  ```[m
[32m+[m[32m  [ type("hi") ]        → rc=3  Runtime error: error.UndefinedFunction[m
[32m+[m[32m  [ int(5)~x type(x) ]  → rc=3  Runtime error: error.UndefinedFunction[m
[32m+[m[32m  ```[m
[32m+[m[32m- **SPEC:** §III.5 `type("Hello")` in `string`; `type(123)~a` gán vào biến.[m
[32m+[m[32m- **Root cause:** `type` không phải keyword/system tag hợp lệ trong parser → parse thành `CallExpr{callee:"type"}` → VM tra `type` như hàm do người dùng định nghĩa → không thấy → `UndefinedFunction`. `callBuiltin` có nhánh `type` nhưng không bao giờ được gọi vì `type(...)` không đi qua đường system tag.[m
[32m+[m[32m- **Mức độ:** MEDIUM — type introspection không dùng được.[m

[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m**Mức độ:** HIGH (đính chính — mục B4 kết luận "bắt đúng ✅" là SAI)[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m### M1.1 Triệu chứng (băng bằng chứng — tất cả đều đi backend BYTECODE mặc định)[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m> **Đọc kỹ:** mọi ca dưới đây không có `func_decl`/`class_decl`/`Import` → `Executor` chọn **bytecode**. Đây chính là backend mà catch bị hỏng (xem M1.2). Khi ép AST walker (thêm func_decl), catch hoạt động đúng.[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m```[m
[32m+[m[32m# catch ĐÚNG error_type, đặt TRƯỚC câu lỗi (BUG.md nói "bắt được ✅")[m
[32m+[m[32m$ ko t_catch_ok.ko[m
[32m+[m[32mtgt/t_catch_ok.ko:main[m
[32m+[m[32mcaught                                              ← body catch ĐÃ chạy[m
[32m+[m[32mRuntime error: error.DivideByZero                   ← nhưng lỗi VẪN nổ[m
[32m+[m[32mrc=3                                                 ← KHÔNG dập được[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m# catch KHÔNG có lỗi — body VẪN chạy[m
[32m+[m[32m$ printf '[ <catch>(`DivideByZeroError`) [ <printf>^("BODY") ] ]' > /tmp/m1c.ko[m
[32m+[m[32m$ ko /tmp/m1c.ko[m
[32m+[m[32mBODY[m
[32m+[m[32mrc=0                                                 ← body chạy dù không có lỗi![m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m# catch SAI error_type — body VẪN chạy (không hề kiểm tra type)[m
[32m+[m[32m$ printf '[ <catch>(`X`) [ <printf>^("BODY") ] <printf>^("tail") ]' > /tmp/m1d.ko[m
[32m+[m[32m$ ko /tmp/m1d.ko[m
[32m+[m[32mBODYtail[m
[32m+[m[32mrc=0[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m# lỗi TRƯỚC catch (đúng backward-scan spec) — KHÔNG bắt[m
[32m+[m[32m$ printf '[ int(1)~a int(0)~b int(a/b)~c <catch>(`DivideByZeroError`) [ <printf>^("caught") ] ]' > /tmp/m1e.ko[m
[32m+[m[32m$ ko /tmp/m1e.ko[m
[32m+[m[32mRuntime error: error.DivideByZero[m
[32m+[m[32mrc=3                                                 ← không in "caught"[m
[32m+[m[32m```[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m### M1.2 Root cause (đã xác minh dứt khoát bằng dump AST + so sánh 2 backend)[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32mĐây là **parity bug**: AST walker xử lý catch **đúng**, nhưng **bytecode backend bỏ qua hoàn toàn semantics catch**.[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m**AST walker handler (`src/vm.zig:585-595`) — ĐÚNG:**[m
[32m+[m[32m```zig[m
[32m+[m[32m.catch_stmt => |cs| {[m
[32m+[m[32m    if (self.has_error) {[m
[32m+[m[32m        if (self.error_type) |err_type| {[m
[32m+[m[32m            if (std.mem.eql(u8, err_type, cs.error_type)) {[m
[32m+[m[32m                self.has_error = false;          // clear cờ[m
[32m+[m[32m                self.error_type = null;[m
[32m+[m[32m                for (cs.body) |s| try self.executeStatement(&s);[m
[32m+[m[32m            }[m
[32m+[m[32m        }[m
[32m+[m[32m    }[m
[32m+[m[32m},[m
[32m+[m[32m```[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m**Bytecode backend (`src/compiler.zig:337-345` + `src/vm.zig:1323-1324`) — SAI:**[m
[32m+[m[32m```zig[m
[32m+[m[32m// compiler.zig: compileCatch — body được emit INLINE, không có cơ chế bắt[m
[32m+[m[32mfn compileCatch(self: *Compiler, c: *const ast.CatchStmt) anyerror!void {[m
[32m+[m[32m    const catch_start = self.current_function.instructions.items.len;[m
[32m+[m[32m    try self.emit(.{ .catch_start = 0 });          // marker[m
[32m+[m[32m    for (0..c.body.len) |i| {[m
[32m+[m[32m        try self.compileStatement(&c.body[i]);      // ← body emit inline, LUÔN chạy[m
[32m+[m[32m    }[m
[32m+[m[32m    try self.emit(.{ .catch_end = {} });            // marker[m
[32m+[m[32m    ...[m
[32m+[m[32m}[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m// vm.zig:1323-1324 — hai opcode này là NO-OP[m
[32m+[m[32m.catch_start => {},[m
[32m+[m[32m.catch_end => {},[m
[32m+[m[32m```[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m→ Trên bytecode, `<catch>` chỉ là **2 marker rỗng** bao quanh body được emit inline. Body **luôn thực thi** như code thường, **không** kiểm tra `has_error`, **không** kiểm tra `error_type`, **không** có logic khôi phục (restore stack / clear error). Vì CLI mặc định chọn bytecode khi source không có `func_decl`/`class_decl`/`Import`, **mọi** chương trình dùng `<catch>` ở dạng phổ biến đều đi đường bytecode → catch vô dụng.[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m**Bằng chứng quyết định (so sánh 2 backend cùng source):**[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m```[m
[32m+[m[32m# BYTECODE (mặc định) — catch body chạy inline, vô điều kiện[m
[32m+[m[32m$ printf '[ <catch>(`X`) [ <printf>^("BODY") ] <printf>^("after") ]' | ko[m
[32m+[m[32mBODYafter        ← body chạy dù KHÔNG có lỗi; "after" cũng chạy[m
[32m+[m[32mrc=0[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m# FORCE AST walker (thêm func_decl dummy để né bytecode) — handler đúng[m
[32m+[m[32m$ printf 'dummy() [ ]\n[ <catch>(`X`) [ <printf>^("BODY") ] <printf>^("after") ]' | ko[m
[32m+[m[32mafter            ← body KHÔNG chạy (has_error=false); chỉ "after"[m
[32m+[m[32mrc=0[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m# FORCE AST + lỗi thật đúng type — bắt được[m
[32m+[m[32m$ printf 'dummy() [ ]\n[ int(1)~a int(0)~b int(a/b)~c <catch>(`DivideByZeroError`) [ <printf>^("caught") ] ]' | ko[m
[32m+[m[32mDivideByZeroError: DivideByZero    ← body catch chạy, in error message[m
[32m+[m[32mrc=3[m
[32m+[m[32m```[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m**Dump AST xác nhận** `<catch>` parse đúng (không phải lỗi parser):[m
[32m+[m[32m```[m
[32m+[m[32mBLOCK body_len=2[m
[32m+[m[32m  CATCH err_type='X' body_len=1[m
[32m+[m[32m    EXPR tag=system_tag[m
[32m+[m[32m  EXPR tag=system_tag[m
[32m+[m[32m```[m
[32m+[m[32m→ AST hoàn toàn đúng. Lỗi nằm ở **bytecode backend không implement catch** (no-op markers), khiến đây là bug parity bytecode ↔ AST walker.[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m> **Liên quan kiến trúc:** `Executor.execute` (`src/executor.zig:52-86`) chọn bytecode khi `!hasFuncOrClassDef && !hasImportStmt`. Catch đơn ở main block thỏa điều kiện này → luôn đi bytecode → luôn hỏng.[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m### M1.3 Đính chính B4[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32mB4 (mục 3.x cũ) viết: *"catch đặt TRƯỚC câu lệnh lỗi thì bắt được: … → in 'caught' ✅"*. **SAI.** Trong báo cáo gốc, các ca catch đều vô tình đi AST walker (do có `func_decl`/class/import) nên "bắt được" — nhưng đó là **AST walker đúng**, không phải bằng chứng catch bytecode hoạt động. Khi chạy thuần bytecode (không func/class/import), catch **không bao giờ** dập lỗi.[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m**Mức độ:** HIGH — `<catch>` trên backend bytecode (mặc định) hoàn toàn không hoạt động: body chạy vô điều kiện, lỗi không bị bắt. Đây là parity bug, không phải lỗi logic AST walker.[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m### M1.4 Hướng sửa (đề xuất)[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m1. **Bytecode:** implement catch thật — `.catch_start` phải ghi lại `catch_handler_ip` + stack depth; khi runtime error xảy ra trong vùng `[catch_start, catch_end)`, VM nhảy tới handler, clear error, khôi phục stack, chạy body. `.catch_end` phân định vùng.[m
[32m+[m[32m2. **Tối thiểu:** ép các chương trình có `<catch>` đi AST walker (đưa catch vào `hasFuncOrClassDef`-style guard) để đảm bảo đúng semantics — nhưng đây chỉ là workaround, không phải fix parity.[m
[32m+[m[32m3. Bổ sung parity test catch qua `Executor` (bytecode) — test hiện tại chỉ đi AST walker nên mù hoàn toàn với bug này.[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m---[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m## 🔴 M2 — Dict literal dạng colon `{'a':1}` hỏng; chỉ compact `(1{'a'})` chạy (đính chính Nhóm D)[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m**Mức độ:** HIGH (đính chính — Nhóm D §"xác nhận đúng" liệt kê dict `{key:val}` là "output đúng" SAI)[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m### M2.1 Triệu chứng[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m```[m
[32m+[m[32m# colon literal KHÔNG ngoặc — gán OK nhưng index/in hỏng[m
[32m+[m[32m$ printf "[ {'a':1}~d <printf>^(d{'a'}) ]" | ko[m
[32m+[m[32mTypeError: Cannot index this type[m
[32m+[m[32mrc=3[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m$ printf "[ {'a':1}~d <printf>^(d) ]" | ko[m
[32m+[m[32mTypeError: Cannot print an unassigned null value[m
[32m+[m[32mrc=3[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m$ printf "[ {'a':1}~d int(<len>^(d))~l <printf>^(l) ]" | ko[m
[32m+[m[32m0                                                    ← dict RỖNG (len=0)[m
[32m+[m[32mrc=0[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m# colon literal CÓ ngoặc — CHẠY ĐÚNG[m
[32m+[m[32m$ printf "[ ({'a':1})~d <printf>^(d) ]" | ko[m
[32m+[m[32m{a: 1}[m
[32m+[m[32mrc=0[m
[32m+[m[32m$ printf "[ ({'a':1})~d int(d{'a'})~x <printf>^(x) ]" | ko[m
[32m+[m[32m1[m
[32m+[m[32mrc=0[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m# compact (1{'a'}) — CHẠY ĐÚNG (đối chứng)[m
[32m+[m[32m$ printf "[ (1{'a'})~d <printf>^(d{1}) ]" | ko[m
[32m+[m[32ma[m
[32m+[m[32mrc=0[m
[32m+[m[32m```[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m### M2.2 Root cause[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m`{'a':1}` ở **đầu statement** bị parser hiểu là **block statement**, KHÔNG phải dict literal.[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m- `src/parser.zig:335-337`: `if (tok == .l_brace) return try self.parseExprStatement();` — nhưng `parsePrimaryExpr` của `parser_expr.zig` chỉ coi `{...}` là dict literal **trong ngữ cảnh expression lồng** (sau `(`, sau toán tử…). Ở đầu statement, `{` rơi vào đường parse khác.[m
[32m+[m[32m- Khi **có ngoặc** `({'a':1})`: `(` → `parsePrimaryExpr` xử lý bên trong → gặp `{` → parse thành dict literal đúng.[m
[32m+[m[32m- Khi **không ngoặc** `{'a':1}~d`: `{` parse sai → `~d` gán cho một biểu thức rỗng/block → dict thật bị mất → `d` thành null/rỗng → `len=0`, index = "Cannot index this type".[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m**Đối chứng quyết định:** cùng nội dung `{'a':1}`, thêm ngoặc `({'a':1})` là chạy đúng → lỗi nằm ở **quy tắc dispatch `{` ở đầu statement**, không phải ở dict value.[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m### M2.3 Đính chính Nhóm D[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32mNhóm D ghi *"dict `{key:val}` → rc=0, output đúng"* là **SAI**. Đúng ra:[m
[32m+[m[32m- `{'a':1}~d` (không ngoặc) → dict rỗng, index lỗi.[m
[32m+[m[32m- `({'a':1})~d` (có ngoặc) → đúng.[m
[32m+[m[32m- `(1{'a'})~d` (compact) → đúng.[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m**Mức độ:** HIGH — cú pháp dict colon theo SPEC §III không dùng được nếu thiếu ngoặc.[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m---[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m## 🟠 M3 — Unknown system tag không nhất quán (bổ sung C1)[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m**Mức độ:** MEDIUM[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m### M3.1 Triệu chứng[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m```[m
[32m+[m[32m$ printf '[ <foo>^("x") ]' | ko       → rc=0, KHÔNG output, KHÔNG lỗi   (im lặng)[m
[32m+[m[32m$ printf '[ <foo>(1) ]' | ko          → rc=3  Runtime error: error.UndefinedFunction[m
[32m+[m[32m$ printf '[ <foo> ]' | ko             → rc=2  error: UnexpectedToken[m
[32m+[m[32m```[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32mCùng tag lạ `<foo>`, ba dạng调用 cho ba kết quả khác nhau:[m
[32m+[m[32m- `<foo>^("x")` (dạng expr statement, có caret) → **im lặng** (C1 cũ).[m
[32m+[m[32m- `<foo>(1)` (dạng expr thường) → `UndefinedFunction`.[m
[32m+[m[32m- `<foo>` trần → parse error.[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m### M3.2 Phân tích[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m`isSystemTagOpener` (`parser.zig:1166-1184`) chỉ nhận `<ident>` / `<ident>(...)>` là system tag opener khi có cặp `<...>`. `<foo>^("x")` được coi là system tag expr → `evaluateSystemTag` (`vm_value_ops.zig:603`) không khớp tag nào → rơi xuống cuối hàm, trả `.null` mà **không báo lỗi** → im lặng.[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32mTrong khi `<foo>(1)` không được nhận là system tag (thiếu `^`?) → parse thành `CallExpr{callee:"foo"}` → VM tra hàm user → `UndefinedFunction`.[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m### M3.3 Hậu quả[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32mCùng một lỗi (tag không tồn tại) nhưng tùy cú pháp lại im lặng / báo khác nhau → khó chẩn đoán. Nên hợp nhất: mọi `<foo>` không xác định → `UnknownSystemTag`.[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m**Mức độ:** MEDIUM — nhất quán chẩn đoán.[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m---[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m## 🟠 Bonus — `freal` ↔ `int` coercion TypeError (bổ sung, Nhóm D nói freal "đúng")[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m**Mức độ:** MEDIUM[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m### B.1 Triệu chứng[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m```[m
[32m+[m[32m$ printf '[ freal(1.5)~a freal(a+1.0)~b <printf>^(b) ]' | ko[m
[32m+[m[32m2.5                                                  ← freal + literal OK[m
[32m+[m[32mrc=0[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m$ printf '[ freal(1.5)~a int(2)~b freal(a+b)~c <printf>^(c) ]' | ko[m
[32m+[m[32mRuntime error: error.TypeError                       ← freal + int biến = TypeError[m
[32m+[m[32mrc=3[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m$ printf '[ int(2)~b freal(1.5)~a freal(a+b)~c <printf>^(c) ]' | ko[m
[32m+[m[32mRuntime error: error.TypeError                       ← int + freal = TypeError[m
[32m+[m[32mrc=3[m
[32m+[m[32m```[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m### B.2 Phân tích[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m- `freal + literal f.` → OK (cùng kiểu freal).[m
[32m+[m[32m- `freal + int` (hai biến khác kiểu) → `TypeError` ở `evaluateBinary` (`vm_value_ops.zig` → `operator.applyBinary`). Không có coercion freal↔int.[m
[32m+[m[32m- SPEC §III.freal không nêu rõ coercion; nhưng người dùng mong đợi `freal + int` chạy (như đa số ngôn ngữ). Đây là **thiếu coercion**, không hẳn sai spec.[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m### B.3 Đề xuất[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32mThêm coercion int→freal trong `applyBinary` khi một vế freal, một vế int. Ghi nhận mức MEDIUM (tùy quyết định spec).[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m---[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m## 🧩 Bonus — Class method in ra "byte rác" trước NameError[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m**Mức độ:** MEDIUM (nghi memory issue nhẹ)[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m### C.1 Triệu chứng (hexdump)[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m```[m
[32m+[m[32m$ ko tgt/t_class_method.ko[m
[32m+[m[32mtgt/t_class_method.ko:main[m
[32m+[m[32mtgt/t_class_method.ko:main- ?? ?? \n NameError: UndefinedVariable[m
[32m+[m[32mrc=3[m
[32m+[m[32m```[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32mHeredump vùng stdout:[m
[32m+[m[32m```[m
[32m+[m[32m00000030: 3a6d 6169 6e2d aaaa aa0a 4e61 6d65 4572  :main-....NameEr[m
[32m+[m[32m```[m
[32m+[m[32m- `aa aa` = **byte rác** (0xAA) xen giữa `main-` và `\nNameError`. `0xAA` là pattern **Zig DebugAllocator freed-memory** (giống BUG-1 cũ) → nghi **use-after-free nhẹ** trong `callUserFunction`/`load_var` khi method không bind `self`.[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m### C.2 Liên quan B3[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32mB3 (class method `self`-binding) đã ghi NameError UndefinedVariable — đúng. Nhưng **chưa ghi** chi tiết: stdout bị chèn `0xAA` rác trước NameError, dấu hiệu memory bug đi kèm, không chỉ thiếu bind. Root cause nghi ở `evaluateCall` nhánh `.class_instance` (`vm_value_ops.zig:197`): lấy `func` từ `ci.methods`, gọi `callUserFunction(f, args)` với `closure_scope` không chứa field → `load_var x` fail → nhưng trước đó có thể đã free nhầm vùng `name` của biến/field.[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m**Mức độ:** MEDIUM — cần Valgrind xác nhận (giống BUG-1/BUG-6).[m
[32m+[m

[31m-## WCAG 2.2 Core Compliance Checklist[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### 1. Perceivable (Information must be presentable)[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- [ ] **Text Alternatives**: All non-text content has a text alternative (Alt text or labels).[m
[31m-- [ ] **Contrast**: Text meets 4.5:1; UI components/graphics meet 3:1 contrast ratios.[m
[31m-- [ ] **Adaptable**: Content reflows and remains functional when resized up to 400%.[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### 2. Operable (Interface components must be usable)[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- [ ] **Keyboard Accessible**: Every interactive element is reachable via keyboard/switch control.[m
[31m-- [ ] **Navigable**: Focus order is logical, and focus indicators are high-contrast (SC 2.4.11).[m
[31m-- [ ] **Pointer Gestures**: Single-pointer alternatives exist for all dragging or multipoint gestures.[m
[31m-- [ ] **Target Size**: Interactive elements are at least 24x24 CSS pixels (SC 2.5.8).[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### 3. Understandable (Information must be clear)[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- [ ] **Predictable**: Navigation and identification of elements are consistent across the app.[m
[31m-- [ ] **Input Assistance**: Forms provide clear error identification and suggestions for fix.[m
[31m-- [ ] **Redundant Entry**: Avoid asking for the same info twice in a single process (SC 3.3.7).[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### 4. Robust (Content must be compatible)[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- [ ] **Compatibility**: Maximize compatibility with assistive tech using valid Name, Role, and Value.[m
[31m-- [ ] **Status Messages**: Screen readers are notified of dynamic changes via ARIA live regions.[m
[31m-[m
[31m----[m
[31m-[m
[31m-## Anti-Patterns[m
[31m-[m
[31m-| Issue                      | Why it fails                                                                                       |[m
[31m-| :------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |[m
[31m-| **"Click Here" Links**     | Non-descriptive; screen reader users navigating by links won't know the destination.               |[m
[31m-| **Fixed-Sized Containers** | Prevents content reflow and breaks the layout at higher zoom levels.                               |[m
[31m-| **Keyboard Traps**         | Prevents users from navigating the rest of the page once they enter a component.                   |[m
[31m-| **Auto-Playing Media**     | Distracting for users with cognitive disabilities; interferes with screen reader audio.            |[m
[31m-| **Empty Buttons**          | Icon-only buttons without an `aria-label` or `accessibilityLabel` are invisible to screen readers. |[m

[31m-## Red Flags[m
[31m-[m
[31m-Watch for these architectural anti-patterns:[m
[31m-- **Big Ball of Mud**: No clear structure[m
[31m-- **Golden Hammer**: Using same solution for everything[m
[31m-- **Premature Optimization**: Optimizing too early[m
[31m-- **Not Invented Here**: Rejecting existing solutions[m
[31m-- **Analysis Paralysis**: Over-planning, under-building[m
[31m-- **Magic**: Unclear, undocumented behavior[m
[31m-- **Tight Coupling**: Components too dependent[m
[31m-- **God Object**: One class/component does everything[m
[31m-[m

[31m-[m
[31m-Example architecture for an AI-powered SaaS platform:[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### Current Architecture[m
[31m-- **Frontend**: Next.js 15 (Vercel/Cloud Run)[m
[31m-- **Backend**: FastAPI or Express (Cloud Run/Railway)[m
[31m-- **Database**: PostgreSQL (Supabase)[m

[31m-3. **Real-time Updates**: Supabase subscriptions for live data[m
[31m-4. **Immutable Patterns**: Spread operators for predictable state[m
[31m-5. **Many Small Files**: High cohesion, low coupling[m

[31m-### Scalability Plan[m
[31m-- **10K users**: Current architecture sufficient[m
[31m-- **100K users**: Add Redis clustering, CDN for static assets[m
[31m-- **1M users**: Microservices architecture, separate read/write databases[m
[31m-- **10M users**: Event-driven architecture, distributed caching, multi-region[m
[31m-[m
[31m-**Remember**: Good architecture enables rapid development, easy maintenance, and confident scaling. The best architecture is simple, clear, and follows established patterns.[m

[31m-## Key Design Principles[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- **Hooks over prompts for reliability**: LLMs forget instructions ~20% of the time. `PostToolUse` hooks enforce checklists at the tool level — the LLM physically cannot skip them.[m
[31m-- **Scripts for deterministic logic**: Calendar math, timezone handling, free-slot calculation — use `calendar-suggest.js`, not the LLM.[m
[31m-- **Knowledge files are memory**: `relationships.md`, `preferences.md`, `todo.md` persist across stateless sessions via git.[m
[31m-- **Rules are system-injected**: `.claude/rules/*.md` files load automatically every session. Unlike prompt instructions, the LLM cannot choose to ignore them.[m

[31m-[m

[31m-## Common False Positives - Skip These[m
[31m-[m
[31m-Patterns that LLM reviewers commonly mis-flag. Skip unless you have evidence[m
[31m-specific to this codebase:[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- **"Consider adding error handling"** on a call whose error path is handled by[m
[31m-  the caller or framework, such as Express error middleware, React error[m
[31m-  boundaries, top-level `try/catch`, or Promise chains with `.catch` upstream.[m
[31m-- **"Missing input validation"** when the function is internal and its callers[m
[31m-  already validate. Trace at least one caller before flagging.[m
[31m-- **"Magic number"** for well-known constants: `200`, `404`, `1000` ms, `60`,[m
[31m-  `24`, `1024`, array index `0` or `-1`, HTTP status codes, and single-use[m
[31m-  local constants whose meaning is obvious from the variable name.[m
[31m-- **"Function too long"** for exhaustive `switch` statements, configuration[m
[31m-  objects, test tables, or generated code. Length is not complexity.[m
[31m-- **"Missing JSDoc"** on single-purpose internal helpers whose name and[m
[31m-  signature are self-describing.[m
[31m-- **"Prefer `const` over `let`"** when the variable is reassigned. Read the[m
[31m-  whole function before flagging.[m
[31m-- **"Possible null dereference"** when the preceding line narrows the type or an[m
[31m-  `if` guard is in scope. Trace type flow instead of pattern-matching on `?.`.[m
[31m-- **"N+1 query"** on fixed-cardinality loops, such as iterating a four-element[m
[31m-  enum, or on paths already using `DataLoader` or batching.[m
[31m-- **"Missing await"** on fire-and-forget calls that are intentionally detached,[m
[31m-  such as logging, metrics, or background queue pushes. Check for a comment or[m
[31m-  `void` prefix before flagging.[m
[31m-- **"Should use TypeScript"** or **"Should have types"** in a JavaScript-only[m
[31m-  file. Match the project's existing language; do not suggest a stack change.[m
[31m-- **"Hardcoded value"** for values in test fixtures, example code, or[m
[31m-  documentation snippets. Tests should have hardcoded expectations.[m
[31m-- **Security theater**: flagging `Math.random()` in a non-cryptographic context[m
[31m-  such as animation, jitter, or sampling, or flagging `eval`/`Function` in a[m
[31m-  plugin system that is explicitly a code-loading surface.[m

[31m-team actually change this in review?" If no, skip.[m

[31m-### Security (CRITICAL)[m
[31m-[m
[31m-These MUST be flagged — they can cause real damage:[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- **Hardcoded credentials** — API keys, passwords, tokens, connection strings in source[m
[31m-- **SQL injection** — String concatenation in queries instead of parameterized queries[m
[31m-- **XSS vulnerabilities** — Unescaped user input rendered in HTML/JSX[m
[31m-- **Path traversal** — User-controlled file paths without sanitization[m
[31m-- **CSRF vulnerabilities** — State-changing endpoints without CSRF protection[m
[31m-- **Authentication bypasses** — Missing auth checks on protected routes[m
[31m-- **Insecure dependencies** — Known vulnerable packages[m
[31m-- **Exposed secrets in logs** — Logging sensitive data (tokens, passwords, PII)[m
[31m-[m
[31m-```typescript[m

[31m-const query = `SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ${userId}`;[m
[31m-[m

[31m-const query = `SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = $1`;[m
[31m-const result = await db.query(query, [userId]);[m

[31m-[m
[31m-// GOOD: Use text content or sanitize[m

[31m-```[m

[31m-## Common Fix Patterns[m
[31m-[m
[31m-| Error | Cause | Fix |[m
[31m-|-------|-------|-----|[m

[31m-| `A value of type 'X?' can't be assigned to type 'X'` | Null safety — nullable not handled | Add `!`, `?? default`, or null check |[m
[31m-| `The argument type 'X' can't be assigned to 'Y'` | Type mismatch | Fix type, add explicit cast, or correct API call |[m
[31m-| `Non-nullable instance field 'x' must be initialized` | Missing initializer | Add initializer, mark `late`, or make nullable |[m
[31m-| `The method 'X' isn't defined for type 'Y'` | Wrong type or wrong import | Check type and imports |[m
[31m-| `'await' applied to non-Future` | Awaiting a non-async value | Remove `await` or make function async |[m
[31m-| `Missing concrete implementation of 'X'` | Abstract interface not fully implemented | Add missing method implementations |[m
[31m-| `The class 'X' doesn't implement 'Y'` | Missing `implements` or missing method | Add method or fix class signature |[m
[31m-| `Because X depends on Y >=A and Z depends on Y <B, version solving failed` | Pub version conflict | Adjust version constraints or add `dependency_overrides` |[m
[31m-| `Could not find a file named "pubspec.yaml"` | Wrong working directory | Run from project root |[m
[31m-| `build_runner: No actions were run` | No changes to build_runner inputs | Force rebuild with `--delete-conflicting-outputs` |[m
[31m-| `Part of directive found, but 'X' expected` | Stale generated file | Delete `.g.dart` file and re-run build_runner |[m
[31m-[m

[31m-## Null Safety Fix Patterns[m
[31m-[m
[31m-```dart[m
[31m-// Error: A value of type 'String?' can't be assigned to type 'String'[m
[31m-// BAD — force unwrap[m
[31m-final name = user.name!;[m
[31m-[m
[31m-// GOOD — provide fallback[m
[31m-final name = user.name ?? 'Unknown';[m
[31m-[m
[31m-// GOOD — guard and return early[m
[31m-if (user.name == null) return;[m
[31m-final name = user.name!; // safe after null check[m
[31m-[m
[31m-// GOOD — Dart 3 pattern matching[m
[31m-final name = switch (user.name) {[m
[31m-  final n? => n,[m
[31m-  null => 'Unknown',[m
[31m-};[m
[31m-```[m
[31m-[m
[31m-## Type Error Fix Patterns[m
[31m-[m
[31m-```dart[m
[31m-// Error: The argument type 'List<dynamic>' can't be assigned to 'List<String>'[m
[31m-// BAD[m
[31m-final ids = jsonList; // inferred as List<dynamic>[m
[31m-[m
[31m-// GOOD[m
[31m-final ids = List<String>.from(jsonList);[m
[31m-// or[m
[31m-final ids = (jsonList as List).cast<String>();[m
[31m-```[m

[31m-## Key Principles[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- **Surgical fixes only** — don't refactor, just fix the error[m
[31m-- **Never** add `// ignore:` suppressions without approval[m
[31m-- **Never** use `dynamic` to silence type errors[m
[31m-- **Always** run `flutter analyze` after each fix to verify[m
[31m-- Fix root cause over suppressing symptoms[m
[31m-- Prefer null-safe patterns over bang operators (`!`)[m
[31m-[m

[31m-[m

[31m-- Same error persists after 3 fix attempts[m
[31m-- Fix introduces more errors than it resolves[m
[31m-- Requires architectural changes or package upgrades that change behavior[m
[31m-- Conflicting platform constraints need user decision[m

[31m-# Database Reviewer[m
[31m-[m
[31m-You are an expert PostgreSQL database specialist focused on query optimization, schema design, security, and performance. Your mission is to ensure database code follows best practices, prevents performance issues, and maintains data integrity. Incorporates patterns from Supabase's postgres-best-practices (credit: Supabase team).[m
[31m-[m
[31m-## Core Responsibilities[m
[31m-[m
[31m-1. **Query Performance** — Optimize queries, add proper indexes, prevent table scans[m
[31m-2. **Schema Design** — Design efficient schemas with proper data types and constraints[m
[31m-3. **Security & RLS** — Implement Row Level Security, least privilege access[m
[31m-4. **Connection Management** — Configure pooling, timeouts, limits[m
[31m-5. **Concurrency** — Prevent deadlocks, optimize locking strategies[m
[31m-6. **Monitoring** — Set up query analysis and performance tracking[m
[31m-[m
[31m-## Diagnostic Commands[m
[31m-[m
[31m-```bash[m
[31m-psql $DATABASE_URL[m
[31m-psql -c "SELECT query, mean_exec_time, calls FROM pg_stat_statements ORDER BY mean_exec_time DESC LIMIT 10;"[m
[31m-psql -c "SELECT relname, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(relid)) FROM pg_stat_user_tables ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(relid) DESC;"[m
[31m-psql -c "SELECT indexrelname, idx_scan, idx_tup_read FROM pg_stat_user_indexes ORDER BY idx_scan DESC;"[m
[31m-```[m
[31m-[m
[31m-## Review Workflow[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### 1. Query Performance (CRITICAL)[m
[31m-- Are WHERE/JOIN columns indexed?[m
[31m-- Run `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` on complex queries — check for Seq Scans on large tables[m
[31m-- Watch for N+1 query patterns[m
[31m-- Verify composite index column order (equality first, then range)[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### 2. Schema Design (HIGH)[m
[31m-- Use proper types: `bigint` for IDs, `text` for strings, `timestamptz` for timestamps, `numeric` for money, `boolean` for flags[m
[31m-- Define constraints: PK, FK with `ON DELETE`, `NOT NULL`, `CHECK`[m
[31m-- Use `lowercase_snake_case` identifiers (no quoted mixed-case)[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### 3. Security (CRITICAL)[m
[31m-- RLS enabled on multi-tenant tables with `(SELECT auth.uid())` pattern[m
[31m-- RLS policy columns indexed[m
[31m-- Least privilege access — no `GRANT ALL` to application users[m
[31m-- Public schema permissions revoked[m
[31m-[m
[31m-## Key Principles[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- **Index foreign keys** — Always, no exceptions[m
[31m-- **Use partial indexes** — `WHERE deleted_at IS NULL` for soft deletes[m
[31m-- **Covering indexes** — `INCLUDE (col)` to avoid table lookups[m
[31m-- **SKIP LOCKED for queues** — 10x throughput for worker patterns[m
[31m-- **Cursor pagination** — `WHERE id > $last` instead of `OFFSET`[m
[31m-- **Batch inserts** — Multi-row `INSERT` or `COPY`, never individual inserts in loops[m
[31m-- **Short transactions** — Never hold locks during external API calls[m
[31m-- **Consistent lock ordering** — `ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE` to prevent deadlocks[m
[31m-[m
[31m-## Anti-Patterns to Flag[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- `SELECT *` in production code[m
[31m-- `int` for IDs (use `bigint`), `varchar(255)` without reason (use `text`)[m
[31m-- `timestamp` without timezone (use `timestamptz`)[m
[31m-- Random UUIDs as PKs (use UUIDv7 or IDENTITY)[m
[31m-- OFFSET pagination on large tables[m
[31m-- Unparameterized queries (SQL injection risk)[m
[31m-- `GRANT ALL` to application users[m
[31m-- RLS policies calling functions per-row (not wrapped in `SELECT`)[m
[31m-[m
[31m-## Review Checklist[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- [ ] All WHERE/JOIN columns indexed[m
[31m-- [ ] Composite indexes in correct column order[m
[31m-- [ ] Proper data types (bigint, text, timestamptz, numeric)[m
[31m-- [ ] RLS enabled on multi-tenant tables[m
[31m-- [ ] RLS policies use `(SELECT auth.uid())` pattern[m
[31m-- [ ] Foreign keys have indexes[m
[31m-- [ ] No N+1 query patterns[m
[31m-- [ ] EXPLAIN ANALYZE run on complex queries[m
[31m-- [ ] Transactions kept short[m
[31m-[m
[31m-## Reference[m
[31m-[m
[31m-For detailed index patterns, schema design examples, connection management, concurrency strategies, JSONB patterns, and full-text search, see skills: `postgres-patterns` and `database-migrations`.[m
[31m-[m
[31m----[m
[31m-[m
[31m-**Remember**: Database issues are often the root cause of application performance problems. Optimize queries and schema design early. Use EXPLAIN ANALYZE to verify assumptions. Always index foreign keys and RLS policy columns.[m

[31m-### Dependency / pip Errors[m

[31m-|-------|-------|-----|[m
[31m-| `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'X'` | Missing package | `pip install X` or add to `requirements.txt` |[m
[31m-| `ImportError: cannot import name 'X' from 'Y'` | Version mismatch | Pin compatible version in requirements |[m
[31m-| `ERROR: pip's dependency resolver...` | Conflicting deps | Upgrade pip: `pip install --upgrade pip`, then `pip install -r requirements.txt` |[m
[31m-| `Poetry: No solution found` | Conflicting constraints | Relax version pin in `pyproject.toml` |[m
[31m-| `pkg_resources.DistributionNotFound` | Installed outside venv | Reinstall inside venv |[m

[31m-[m

[31m-poetry cache clear --all pypi[m
[31m-poetry install[m
[31m-[m
[31m-# Create fresh virtualenv if corrupt[m
[31m-deactivate[m

[31m-pip install -r requirements.txt[m

[31m-| `django.db.utils.OperationalError: no such column` | Unapplied migration | `python manage.py migrate` |[m

[31m-## Review Priorities[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### CRITICAL — Security[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- **SQL Injection**: Raw SQL with f-strings or `%` formatting — use `%s` parameters or ORM[m
[31m-- **`mark_safe` on user input**: Never without explicit `escape()` first[m
[31m-- **CSRF exemption without reason**: `@csrf_exempt` on non-webhook views[m
[31m-- **`DEBUG = True` in production settings**: Leaks full stack traces[m
[31m-- **Hardcoded `SECRET_KEY`**: Must come from environment variable[m
[31m-- **Missing `permission_classes` on DRF views**: Defaults to global — verify intent[m
[31m-- **`eval()`/`exec()` on user input**: Immediate block[m
[31m-- **File upload without extension/size validation**: Path traversal risk[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### CRITICAL — ORM Correctness[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- **N+1 queries in loops**: Accessing related objects without `select_related`/`prefetch_related`[m
[31m-  ```python[m
[31m-  # Bad[m
[31m-  for order in Order.objects.all():[m
[31m-      print(order.user.email)  # N+1[m
[31m-[m
[31m-  # Good[m
[31m-  for order in Order.objects.select_related('user').all():[m
[31m-      print(order.user.email)[m
[31m-  ```[m
[31m-- **Missing `atomic()` for multi-step writes**: Use `transaction.atomic()` for any sequence of DB writes[m
[31m-- **`bulk_create` without `update_conflicts`**: Silent data loss on duplicate keys[m
[31m-- **`get()` without `DoesNotExist` handling**: Unhandled exception risk[m
[31m-- **Queryset used after `delete()`**: Stale queryset reference[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### CRITICAL — Migration Safety[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- **Model change without migration**: Run `python manage.py makemigrations --check`[m
[31m-- **Backward-incompatible column drop**: Must be done in two deployments (nullable first)[m
[31m-- **`RunPython` without `reverse_code`**: Migration cannot be reversed[m
[31m-- **`atomic = False` without justification**: Leaves DB in partial state on failure[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### HIGH — DRF Patterns[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- **Serializer without explicit `fields`**: `fields = '__all__'` exposes all columns including sensitive ones[m
[31m-- **No pagination on list endpoints**: Unbounded queries can return millions of rows[m
[31m-- **Missing `read_only_fields`**: Auto-generated fields (id, created_at) editable by API[m
[31m-- **`perform_create` not used**: Injecting user context should happen in `perform_create`, not `validate`[m
[31m-- **No throttling on auth endpoints**: Login/registration open to brute force[m
[31m-- **Nested writable serializers without `update()`**: Default update silently ignores nested data[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### HIGH — Performance[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- **Queryset evaluated in template context**: Use `.values()` or pass list; avoid lazy evaluation in templates[m
[31m-- **Missing `db_index` on FK/filter fields**: Full table scan on filtered queries[m
[31m-- **Synchronous external API call in view**: Blocks the request thread — offload to Celery[m
[31m-- **`len(queryset)` instead of `.count()`**: Forces full fetch[m
[31m-- **`exists()` not used for existence checks**: `if queryset:` fetches objects unnecessarily[m
[31m-[m
[31m-  ```python[m
[31m-  # Bad[m
[31m-  if Product.objects.filter(sku=sku):[m
[31m-      ...[m
[31m-[m
[31m-  # Good[m
[31m-  if Product.objects.filter(sku=sku).exists():[m
[31m-      ...[m
[31m-  ```[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### HIGH — Code Quality[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- **Business logic in views or serializers**: Move to `services.py`[m
[31m-- **Signal logic that belongs in a service**: Signals make flow hard to trace — use explicitly[m
[31m-- **Mutable default in model field**: `default=[]` or `default={}` — use `default=list`[m
[31m-- **`save()` called without `update_fields`**: Overwrites all columns — risk of clobbering concurrent writes[m
[31m-[m
[31m-  ```python[m
[31m-  # Bad[m
[31m-  user.last_active = now()[m
[31m-  user.save()[m
[31m-[m
[31m-  # Good[m
[31m-  user.last_active = now()[m
[31m-  user.save(update_fields=['last_active'])[m
[31m-  ```[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### MEDIUM — Best Practices[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- **`str(queryset)` or slicing for debug**: Use Django shell, not production code[m
[31m-- **Accessing `request.user` in serializer `validate()`**: Pass via context, not direct access[m
[31m-- **`print()` instead of `logger`**: Use `logging.getLogger(__name__)`[m
[31m-- **Missing `related_name`**: Reverse accessors like `user_set` are confusing[m
[31m-- **`blank=True` without `null=True` on non-string fields**: DB stores empty string for non-string types[m
[31m-- **Hardcoded URLs**: Use `reverse()` or `reverse_lazy()`[m
[31m-- **Missing `__str__` on models**: Django admin and logging are broken without it[m
[31m-- **App not using `AppConfig.ready()`**: Signal receivers not connected properly[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### MEDIUM — Testing Gaps[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- **No test for permission boundary**: Verify unauthorized access returns 403/401[m
[31m-- **`force_authenticate` instead of proper token**: Tests skip auth logic entirely[m
[31m-- **Missing `@pytest.mark.django_db`**: Tests silently hit no DB[m
[31m-- **Factory not used**: Raw `Model.objects.create()` in tests is fragile[m

[31m-## Key Principles[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- **Use semantic locators**: `[data-testid="..."]` > CSS selectors > XPath[m

[31m-// npx playwright test --repeat-each=10[m

[31m-## Review Checklist[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### Architecture (CRITICAL)[m
[31m-[m
[31m-Adapt to the project's chosen architecture (Clean Architecture, MVVM, feature-first, etc.):[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- **Business logic in widgets** — Complex logic belongs in a state management component, not in `build()` or callbacks[m
[31m-- **Data models leaking across layers** — If the project separates DTOs and domain entities, they must be mapped at boundaries; if models are shared, review for consistency[m
[31m-- **Cross-layer imports** — Imports must respect the project's layer boundaries; inner layers must not depend on outer layers[m
[31m-- **Framework leaking into pure-Dart layers** — If the project has a domain/model layer intended to be framework-free, it must not import Flutter or platform code[m
[31m-- **Circular dependencies** — Package A depends on B and B depends on A[m
[31m-- **Private `src/` imports across packages** — Importing `package:other/src/internal.dart` breaks Dart package encapsulation[m
[31m-- **Direct instantiation in business logic** — State managers should receive dependencies via injection, not construct them internally[m
[31m-- **Missing abstractions at layer boundaries** — Concrete classes imported across layers instead of depending on interfaces[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### State Management (CRITICAL)[m
[31m-[m
[31m-**Universal (all solutions):**[m
[31m-- **Boolean flag soup** — `isLoading`/`isError`/`hasData` as separate fields allows impossible states; use sealed types, union variants, or the solution's built-in async state type[m
[31m-- **Non-exhaustive state handling** — All state variants must be handled exhaustively; unhandled variants silently break[m
[31m-- **Single responsibility violated** — Avoid "god" managers handling unrelated concerns[m
[31m-- **Direct API/DB calls from widgets** — Data access should go through a service/repository layer[m
[31m-- **Subscribing in `build()`** — Never call `.listen()` inside build methods; use declarative builders[m
[31m-- **Stream/subscription leaks** — All manual subscriptions must be cancelled in `dispose()`/`close()`[m
[31m-- **Missing error/loading states** — Every async operation must model loading, success, and error distinctly[m
[31m-[m
[31m-**Immutable-state solutions (BLoC, Riverpod, Redux):**[m
[31m-- **Mutable state** — State must be immutable; create new instances via `copyWith`, never mutate in-place[m
[31m-- **Missing value equality** — State classes must implement `==`/`hashCode` so the framework detects changes[m
[31m-[m
[31m-**Reactive-mutation solutions (MobX, GetX, Signals):**[m
[31m-- **Mutations outside reactivity API** — State must only change through `@action`, `.value`, `.obs`, etc.; direct mutation bypasses tracking[m
[31m-- **Missing computed state** — Derivable values should use the solution's computed mechanism, not be stored redundantly[m
[31m-[m
[31m-**Cross-component dependencies:**[m
[31m-- In **Riverpod**, `ref.watch` between providers is expected — flag only circular or tangled chains[m
[31m-- In **BLoC**, blocs should not directly depend on other blocs — prefer shared repositories[m
[31m-- In other solutions, follow documented conventions for inter-component communication[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### Widget Composition (HIGH)[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- **Oversized `build()`** — Exceeding ~80 lines; extract subtrees to separate widget classes[m
[31m-- **`_build*()` helper methods** — Private methods returning widgets prevent framework optimizations; extract to classes[m
[31m-- **Missing `const` constructors** — Widgets with all-final fields must declare `const` to prevent unnecessary rebuilds[m
[31m-- **Object allocation in parameters** — Inline `TextStyle(...)` without `const` causes rebuilds[m
[31m-- **`StatefulWidget` overuse** — Prefer `StatelessWidget` when no mutable local state is needed[m
[31m-- **Missing `key` in list items** — `ListView.builder` items without stable `ValueKey` cause state bugs[m
[31m-- **Hardcoded colors/text styles** — Use `Theme.of(context).colorScheme`/`textTheme`; hardcoded styles break dark mode[m
[31m-- **Hardcoded spacing** — Prefer design tokens or named constants over magic numbers[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### Performance (HIGH)[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- **Unnecessary rebuilds** — State consumers wrapping too much tree; scope narrow and use selectors[m
[31m-- **Expensive work in `build()`** — Sorting, filtering, regex, or I/O in build; compute in the state layer[m
[31m-- **`MediaQuery.of(context)` overuse** — Use specific accessors (`MediaQuery.sizeOf(context)`)[m
[31m-- **Concrete list constructors for large data** — Use `ListView.builder`/`GridView.builder` for lazy construction[m
[31m-- **Missing image optimization** — No caching, no `cacheWidth`/`cacheHeight`, full-res thumbnails[m
[31m-- **`Opacity` in animations** — Use `AnimatedOpacity` or `FadeTransition`[m
[31m-- **Missing `const` propagation** — `const` widgets stop rebuild propagation; use wherever possible[m
[31m-- **`IntrinsicHeight`/`IntrinsicWidth` overuse** — Cause extra layout passes; avoid in scrollable lists[m
[31m-- **`RepaintBoundary` missing** — Complex independently-repainting subtrees should be wrapped[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### Dart Idioms (MEDIUM)[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- **Missing type annotations / implicit `dynamic`** — Enable `strict-casts`, `strict-inference`, `strict-raw-types` to catch these[m
[31m-- **`!` bang overuse** — Prefer `?.`, `??`, `case var v?`, or `requireNotNull`[m
[31m-- **Broad exception catching** — `catch (e)` without `on` clause; specify exception types[m
[31m-- **Catching `Error` subtypes** — `Error` indicates bugs, not recoverable conditions[m
[31m-- **`var` where `final` works** — Prefer `final` for locals, `const` for compile-time constants[m
[31m-- **Relative imports** — Use `package:` imports for consistency[m
[31m-- **Missing Dart 3 patterns** — Prefer switch expressions and `if-case` over verbose `is` checks[m
[31m-- **`print()` in production** — Use `dart:developer` `log()` or the project's logging package[m
[31m-- **`late` overuse** — Prefer nullable types or constructor initialization[m
[31m-- **Ignoring `Future` return values** — Use `await` or mark with `unawaited()`[m
[31m-- **Unused `async`** — Functions marked `async` that never `await` add unnecessary overhead[m
[31m-- **Mutable collections exposed** — Public APIs should return unmodifiable views[m
[31m-- **String concatenation in loops** — Use `StringBuffer` for iterative building[m
[31m-- **Mutable fields in `const` classes** — Fields in `const` constructor classes must be final[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### Resource Lifecycle (HIGH)[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- **Missing `dispose()`** — Every resource from `initState()` (controllers, subscriptions, timers) must be disposed[m
[31m-- **`BuildContext` used after `await`** — Check `context.mounted` (Flutter 3.7+) before navigation/dialogs after async gaps[m
[31m-- **`setState` after `dispose`** — Async callbacks must check `mounted` before calling `setState`[m
[31m-- **`BuildContext` stored in long-lived objects** — Never store context in singletons or static fields[m
[31m-- **Unclosed `StreamController`** / **`Timer` not cancelled** — Must be cleaned up in `dispose()`[m
[31m-- **Duplicated lifecycle logic** — Identical init/dispose blocks should be extracted to reusable patterns[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### Error Handling (HIGH)[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- **Missing global error capture** — Both `FlutterError.onError` and `PlatformDispatcher.instance.onError` must be set[m
[31m-- **No error reporting service** — Crashlytics/Sentry or equivalent should be integrated with non-fatal reporting[m
[31m-- **Missing state management error observer** — Wire errors to reporting (BlocObserver, ProviderObserver, etc.)[m
[31m-- **Red screen in production** — `ErrorWidget.builder` not customized for release mode[m
[31m-- **Raw exceptions reaching UI** — Map to user-friendly, localized messages before presentation layer[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### Testing (HIGH)[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- **Missing unit tests** — State manager changes must have corresponding tests[m
[31m-- **Missing widget tests** — New/changed widgets should have widget tests[m
[31m-- **Missing golden tests** — Design-critical components should have pixel-perfect regression tests[m
[31m-- **Untested state transitions** — All paths (loading→success, loading→error, retry, empty) must be tested[m
[31m-- **Test isolation violated** — External dependencies must be mocked; no shared mutable state between tests[m
[31m-- **Flaky async tests** — Use `pumpAndSettle` or explicit `pump(Duration)`, not timing assumptions[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### Accessibility (MEDIUM)[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- **Missing semantic labels** — Images without `semanticLabel`, icons without `tooltip`[m
[31m-- **Small tap targets** — Interactive elements below 48x48 pixels[m
[31m-- **Color-only indicators** — Color alone conveying meaning without icon/text alternative[m
[31m-- **Missing `ExcludeSemantics`/`MergeSemantics`** — Decorative elements and related widget groups need proper semantics[m
[31m-- **Text scaling ignored** — Hardcoded sizes that don't respect system accessibility settings[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### Platform, Responsive & Navigation (MEDIUM)[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- **Missing `SafeArea`** — Content obscured by notches/status bars[m
[31m-- **Broken back navigation** — Android back button or iOS swipe-to-go-back not working as expected[m
[31m-- **Missing platform permissions** — Required permissions not declared in `AndroidManifest.xml` or `Info.plist`[m
[31m-- **No responsive layout** — Fixed layouts that break on tablets/desktops/landscape[m
[31m-- **Text overflow** — Unbounded text without `Flexible`/`Expanded`/`FittedBox`[m
[31m-- **Mixed navigation patterns** — `Navigator.push` mixed with declarative router; pick one[m
[31m-- **Hardcoded route paths** — Use constants, enums, or generated routes[m
[31m-- **Missing deep link validation** — URLs not sanitized before navigation[m
[31m-- **Missing auth guards** — Protected routes accessible without redirect[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### Internationalization (MEDIUM)[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- **Hardcoded user-facing strings** — All visible text must use a localization system[m
[31m-- **String concatenation for localized text** — Use parameterized messages[m
[31m-- **Locale-unaware formatting** — Dates, numbers, currencies must use locale-aware formatters[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### Dependencies & Build (LOW)[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- **No strict static analysis** — Project should have strict `analysis_options.yaml`[m
[31m-- **Stale/unused dependencies** — Run `flutter pub outdated`; remove unused packages[m
[31m-- **Dependency overrides in production** — Only with comment linking to tracking issue[m
[31m-- **Unjustified lint suppressions** — `// ignore:` without explanatory comment[m
[31m-- **Hardcoded path deps in monorepo** — Use workspace resolution, not `path: ../../`[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### Security (CRITICAL)[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- **Hardcoded secrets** — API keys, tokens, or credentials in Dart source[m
[31m-- **Insecure storage** — Sensitive data in plaintext instead of Keychain/EncryptedSharedPreferences[m
[31m-- **Cleartext traffic** — HTTP without HTTPS; missing network security config[m
[31m-- **Sensitive logging** — Tokens, PII, or credentials in `print()`/`debugPrint()`[m
[31m-- **Missing input validation** — User input passed to APIs/navigation without sanitization[m

[31m-## Review Priorities[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### CRITICAL - Security[m
[31m-- **SQL Injection**: String concatenation/interpolation in queries - use parameterized queries[m
[31m-- **Command Injection**: Unvalidated input in `Process.Start` - validate and sanitize[m
[31m-- **Path Traversal**: User-controlled file paths - use `Path.GetFullPath` + prefix check[m
[31m-- **Insecure Deserialization**: `BinaryFormatter`, unsafe JSON settings[m
[31m-- **Hardcoded secrets**: API keys, connection strings in source - use configuration/secret manager[m
[31m-- **CSRF/XSS**: Missing anti-forgery tokens, unencoded output in views[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### CRITICAL - Error Handling[m
[31m-- **Swallowed exceptions**: `with _ -> ()` or `with _ -> None` - handle or reraise[m
[31m-- **Missing disposal**: Manual disposal of `IDisposable` - use `use` or `use!` bindings[m
[31m-- **Blocking async**: `.Result`, `.Wait()`, `.GetAwaiter().GetResult()` - use `let!` or `do!`[m
[31m-- **Bare `failwith` in library code**: Prefer `Result` or `Option` for expected failures[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### HIGH - Functional Idioms[m
[31m-- **Mutable state in domain logic**: `mutable`, `ref` cells where immutable alternatives exist[m
[31m-- **Incomplete pattern matches**: Missing cases or catch-all `_` that hides new union cases[m
[31m-- **Imperative loops**: `for`/`while` where `List.map`, `Seq.filter`, `Array.fold` are clearer[m
[31m-- **Null usage**: Using `null` instead of `Option<'T>` for missing values[m
[31m-- **Class-heavy design**: OOP-style classes where modules + functions + records suffice[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### HIGH - Type Safety[m
[31m-- **Primitive obsession**: Raw strings/ints for domain concepts - use single-case DUs[m
[31m-- **Unvalidated input**: Missing validation at system boundaries - use smart constructors[m
[31m-- **Downcasting**: `:?>` without type test - use pattern matching with `:? T as t`[m
[31m-- **`obj` usage**: Avoid `obj` boxing; prefer generics or explicit union types[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### HIGH - Code Quality[m
[31m-- **Large functions**: Over 40 lines - extract helper functions[m
[31m-- **Deep nesting**: More than 3 levels - use early returns, `Result.bind`, or computation expressions[m
[31m-- **Missing `[<RequireQualifiedAccess>]`**: On modules/unions that could cause name collisions[m
[31m-- **Unused `open` declarations**: Remove unused module imports[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### MEDIUM - Performance[m
[31m-- **Seq in hot paths**: Lazy sequences recomputed repeatedly - materialize with `Seq.toList` or `Seq.toArray`[m
[31m-- **String concatenation in loops**: Use `StringBuilder` or `String.concat`[m
[31m-- **Excessive boxing**: Value types passed through `obj` - use generic functions[m
[31m-- **N+1 queries**: Lazy loading in loops when using EF Core - use eager loading[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### MEDIUM - Best Practices[m
[31m-- **Naming conventions**: camelCase for functions/values, PascalCase for types/modules/DU cases[m
[31m-- **Pipe operator readability**: Overly long chains - break into named intermediate bindings[m
[31m-- **Computation expression misuse**: Nested `task { task { } }` - flatten with `let!`[m
[31m-- **Module organization**: Related functions scattered across files - group cohesively[m

[31m-## Common Fix Patterns[m
[31m-[m
[31m-| Error | Cause | Fix |[m
[31m-|-------|-------|-----|[m
[31m-| `undefined: X` | Missing import, typo, unexported | Add import or fix casing |[m
[31m-| `cannot use X as type Y` | Type mismatch, pointer/value | Type conversion or dereference |[m
[31m-| `X does not implement Y` | Missing method | Implement method with correct receiver |[m
[31m-| `import cycle not allowed` | Circular dependency | Extract shared types to new package |[m
[31m-| `cannot find package` | Missing dependency | `go get pkg@version` or `go mod tidy` |[m
[31m-| `missing return` | Incomplete control flow | Add return statement |[m
[31m-| `declared but not used` | Unused var/import | Remove or use blank identifier |[m
[31m-| `multiple-value in single-value context` | Unhandled return | `result, err := func()` |[m
[31m-| `cannot assign to struct field in map` | Map value mutation | Use pointer map or copy-modify-reassign |[m
[31m-| `invalid type assertion` | Assert on non-interface | Only assert from `interface{}` |[m

[31m-[m
[31m-## ArkTS Syntax Constraints (Compilation Blockers)[m
[31m-[m
[31m-ArkTS is a strict subset of TypeScript. The following are NOT supported and will cause compilation failures:[m
[31m-[m
[31m-**Type System:**[m
[31m-- No `any` or `unknown` types - use explicit types[m
[31m-- No index access types - use type names[m
[31m-- No conditional type aliases or `infer` keyword[m
[31m-- No intersection types - use inheritance[m
[31m-- No mapped types - use classes[m
[31m-- No `typeof` for type annotations - use explicit type declarations[m
[31m-- No `as const` assertions - use explicit type annotations[m
[31m-- No structural typing - use inheritance, interfaces, or type aliases[m
[31m-- No TypeScript utility types except `Partial`, `Required`, `Readonly`, `Record`[m
[31m-[m
[31m-**Functions & Classes:**[m
[31m-- No function expressions - use arrow functions[m
[31m-- No nested functions - use lambdas[m
[31m-- No generator functions - use async/await[m
[31m-- No `Function.apply`, `Function.call`, `Function.bind`[m
[31m-- No constructor type expressions - use lambdas[m
[31m-- No constructor signatures in interfaces or object types[m
[31m-- No declaring class fields in constructors - declare in class body[m
[31m-- No `this` in standalone functions or static methods[m
[31m-- No `new.target`[m
[31m-[m
[31m-**Object & Property Access:**[m
[31m-- No dynamic field declaration or `obj["field"]` access - use `obj.field`[m
[31m-- No `delete` operator - use nullable type with `null`[m
[31m-- No prototype assignment[m
[31m-- No `in` operator - use `instanceof`[m
[31m-- No `Symbol()` API (except `Symbol.iterator`)[m
[31m-- No `globalThis` or global scope - use explicit module exports/imports[m
[31m-[m
[31m-**Destructuring & Spread:**[m
[31m-- No destructuring assignments or variable declarations[m
[31m-- No destructuring parameter declarations[m
[31m-- Spread operator only for arrays into rest parameters or array literals[m
[31m-[m
[31m-**Modules & Imports:**[m
[31m-- No `require()` imports - use regular `import`[m
[31m-- No `export = ...` syntax - use normal export/import[m
[31m-- No import assertions[m
[31m-- No UMD modules[m
[31m-- No wildcards in module names[m
[31m-- All `import` statements must precede other statements[m
[31m-[m
[31m-**Other:**[m
[31m-- No `var` keyword - use `let`[m
[31m-- No `for...in` loops - use regular `for` loops for arrays[m
[31m-- No `with` statements[m
[31m-- No JSX expressions[m
[31m-- No `#` private identifiers - use `private` keyword[m
[31m-- No declaration merging[m
[31m-- No index signatures - use arrays[m
[31m-- No class literals - use named class types[m
[31m-- Comma operator only in `for` loops[m
[31m-- Unary operators `+`, `-`, `~` only for numeric types[m
[31m-- Omit type annotations in `catch` clauses[m
[31m-[m
[31m-**Object Literals:**[m
[31m-- Supported only when compiler can infer the corresponding class/interface[m
[31m-- Not supported for: `any`/`Object`/`object` types, classes with methods, classes with parameterized constructors, classes with `readonly` fields[m
[31m-[m
[31m-## HarmonyOS API Usage Guidelines[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- Prefer official HarmonyOS APIs, UI components, animations, and code templates[m
[31m-- Verify API parameters, return values, API level, and device support before use[m
[31m-- When uncertain about syntax or API usage, search official Huawei developer documentation - never guess[m
[31m-- Confirm `import` statements are added at file header before using APIs[m
[31m-- Verify required permissions in `module.json5` before calling APIs[m
[31m-- Verify dependency existence and version compatibility in `oh-package.json5`[m
[31m-- Enforce `@ComponentV2` for all new or modified ArkUI components; when encountering legacy `@Component`, recommend migration to V2[m
[31m-- Define UI display constants as resources, reference via `$r()` - avoid hardcoded literals[m
[31m-- Add i18n resource strings to all language directories when creating new entries[m
[31m-- Check if new color resources need dark theme support (recommended for new projects)[m
[31m-[m
[31m-## ArkUI Animation Guidelines[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- Prefer native HarmonyOS animation APIs and advanced templates[m
[31m-- Use declarative UI with state-driven animations (change state variables to trigger animations)[m
[31m-- Set `renderGroup(true)` for complex sub-component animations to reduce render batches[m
[31m-- NEVER frequently change `width`, `height`, `padding`, `margin` during animations - severe performance impact[m
[31m-[m
[31m-## Behavior Guidelines[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- **Proactive refactoring**: If user code contains V1 state management or `router` routing, proactively flag it and refactor to V2 + Navigation[m
[31m-- **Explain best practices**: Briefly explain why a solution is "best practice" (e.g., performance advantages of `@ComponentV2` over V1)[m
[31m-- **Rigor**: Ensure code snippets are complete, runnable, and handle common edge cases (empty data, loading states, error handling)[m
[31m-[m

[31m-```[m

[31m-Final: `Status: SUCCESS/NEEDS_WORK | Issues Found: N | Files Modified: list`[m

[31m-For detailed HarmonyOS patterns and code examples, refer to rule files in `rules/arkts/`.[m

[31m-## Common Fix Patterns[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### General Java[m
[31m-[m
[31m-| Error | Cause | Fix |[m
[31m-|-------|-------|-----|[m
[31m-| `cannot find symbol` | Missing import, typo, missing dependency | Add import or dependency |[m
[31m-| `incompatible types: X cannot be converted to Y` | Wrong type, missing cast | Add explicit cast or fix type |[m
[31m-| `method X in class Y cannot be applied to given types` | Wrong argument types or count | Fix arguments or check overloads |[m
[31m-| `variable X might not have been initialized` | Uninitialized local variable | Initialise variable before use |[m
[31m-| `non-static method X cannot be referenced from a static context` | Instance method called statically | Create instance or make method static |[m
[31m-| `reached end of file while parsing` | Missing closing brace | Add missing `}` |[m
[31m-| `package X does not exist` | Missing dependency or wrong import | Add dependency to `pom.xml`/`build.gradle` |[m
[31m-| `error: cannot access X, class file not found` | Missing transitive dependency | Add explicit dependency |[m
[31m-| `Annotation processor threw uncaught exception` | Lombok/MapStruct misconfiguration | Check annotation processor setup |[m
[31m-| `Could not resolve: group:artifact:version` | Missing repository or wrong version | Add repository or fix version in POM |[m
[31m-| `The following artifacts could not be resolved` | Private repo or network issue | Check repository credentials or `settings.xml` |[m
[31m-| `COMPILATION ERROR: Source option X is no longer supported` | Java version mismatch | Update `maven.compiler.source` / `targetCompatibility` |[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### [SPRING] Spring Boot Specific[m
[31m-[m
[31m-| Error | Cause | Fix |[m
[31m-|-------|-------|-----|[m
[31m-| `No qualifying bean of type X` | Missing `@Component`/`@Service` or component scan | Add annotation or fix scan base package |[m
[31m-| `Circular dependency involving X` | Constructor injection cycle | Refactor to break cycle or use `@Lazy` on one leg |[m
[31m-| `BeanCreationException: Error creating bean` | Missing config, bad property, or missing dependency | Check `application.yml`, dependency tree |[m
[31m-| `HttpMessageNotReadableException` | Malformed JSON or missing Jackson dependency | Check `spring-boot-starter-web` includes Jackson |[m
[31m-| `Could not autowire. No beans of type found` | Missing bean or wrong profile active | Check `@Profile`, `@ConditionalOn*`, component scan |[m
[31m-| `Failed to configure a DataSource` | Missing DB driver or datasource properties | Add driver dependency or `spring.datasource.*` config |[m
[31m-| `spring-boot-starter-* not found` | BOM version mismatch | Check `spring-boot-dependencies` BOM version in parent |[m
[31m-[m
[31m-### [QUARKUS] Quarkus Specific[m
[31m-[m
[31m-| Error | Cause | Fix |[m
[31m-|-------|-------|-----|[m
[31m-| `UnsatisfiedResolutionException: no bean found` | Missing `@ApplicationScoped`/`@Inject` or missing extension | Add CDI annotation or `quarkus-*` extension |[m
[31m-| `AmbiguousResolutionException` | Multiple beans match injection point | Add `@Priority`, `@Alternative`, or qualifier |[m
[31m-| `Build step X threw an exception: RuntimeException` | Quarkus build-time augmentation failure | Read full stack trace — usually a missing extension, bad config, or reflection issue |[m
[31m-| `Error injecting X: it's a non-proxyable bean type` | `@Singleton` with interceptor or `final` class | Switch to `@ApplicationScoped` or remove `final` |[m
[31m-| `ClassNotFoundException at native image build` | Missing `@RegisterForReflection` or reflection config | Add `@RegisterForReflection` or `reflect-config.json` entry |[m
[31m-| `BlockingNotAllowedOnIOThread` | Blocking call on Vert.x event loop | Add `@Blocking` to endpoint or use reactive client |[m
[31m-| `ConfigurationException: SRCFG*` | Missing or malformed config property | Check `application.properties` for required `quarkus.*` or `mp.*` keys |[m
[31m-| `quarkus-extension-* not found` | Wrong BOM version or extension not in BOM | Check `quarkus-bom` version; use `quarkus ext add <name>` |[m
[31m-| `DEV mode hot reload failure` | Incompatible change during dev mode | Run `./mvnw quarkus:dev` with clean: `./mvnw clean quarkus:dev` |[m
[31m-| `Panache entity not enhanced` | Entity not detected at build time | Ensure entity is in scanned package; check for missing `quarkus-hibernate-orm-panache` or `quarkus-mongodb-panache` extension |[m
[31m-| `RESTEASY* deployment failure` | Duplicate JAX-RS paths or missing provider | Check `@Path` uniqueness; ensure `quarkus-resteasy-reactive` vs `quarkus-resteasy` are not mixed |[m

[31m-## Key Principles[m
[31m-[m
[31m-- **Surgical fixes only** — don't refactor, just fix the error[m
[31m-- **Never** suppress warnings with `@SuppressWarnings` without explicit approval[m
[31m-- **Never** change method signatures unless necessary[m
[31m-- **Always** run the build after each fix to verify[m
[31m-- Fix root cause over suppressing symptoms[m
[31m-- Prefer adding missing imports over changing logic[m
[31m-- **[QUARKUS]**: Prefer `quarkus ext add` over manually editing `pom.xml` for extensions[m
[31m-- **[QUARKUS]**: Always check if `@RegisterForReflection` is needed before adding reflection config manually[m
[31m-- Check `pom.xml`, `build.gradle`, or `build.gradle.kts` to confirm the build tool before running commands[m

[31m-[m

[31m-- Same error persists after 3 fix attempts[m

[31m-- Error requires architectural changes beyond scope[m
[31m-- Missing external dependencies that need user decision (private repos, licences)[m
[31m-- **[QUARKUS]**: Native image build fails due to GraalVM not being installed — report prerequisite[m
